svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: End blocks (make 2): cut 60 mm of 22 mm square bar; file to 21 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square, a sliding fit in the tube. Drill and ream 14 mm along

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre, right through. Cross holes 6.5 mm at 10 and 25 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the inner end, through two opposite faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stubs: cut 14 mm keyed shaft (5 mm key) to 148 mm for the drive

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (right) side and 108 mm for the spring (left) side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each stub goes 38 mm into its block. With the stub in the block in

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the tube, drill 5 mm through tube, block and stub 20 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube end and drive in a 5 x 24 mm roll pin (step 11).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left stub only: saw a 3 mm slot 10 mm deep across its outer end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the inner end of the spiral spring.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: block bolted in the tube end with two M6 bolts; stub through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bronze bush, into the gearbox bore (right) or spring can (left).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the stub turns the tube with no play once pinned.
